notes.title: Balancing Patch
notes.content:
Hey all,

This update focuses on making the game more difficult and the AI smarter. I did a major buff patch a few months ago, and since then average playtime has dropped so this patch aims to make the game more fun and engaging by having more difficulty in the combat.

Here is the patch notes for this update:

AI Improvements:

 All enemies will now properly track you if you get close to them even if their reposition isn't finished.
 Mirage(Speedster enemy) now has more health.


General Changes:

 The health bar will now animate when changes happen to it.
 Player health has been nerfed significantly.
 Player health regeneration now happens once every 1 second as long as you are not being hit by enemies. It has a 10% increase for each tick.

notes.title: Hotfix For Leaderboards
notes.content: This patch fixes a bug where the leaderboards would not show a mouse cursor causing you to get stuck in the menu.

notes.title: Leaderboard Improvements
notes.content:
Changes in this update include:

1. New Leaderboard design with steam integration, your leaderboard name will be taken from the steam platform instead of being manually inputted for easier and more accurate tracking. Score willl also be added to the leaderboard even if its not open like when you get a kill.
2. A new hit animation for boltbreak when a enemy hits you.
3. Improved steam support on the backend.
4. A new water shader that looks better and is more performant.
5. Various bug fixes.

Old anonymous usernames on the leaderboard will be deleted, to update your score with your new name just enter the game and kill at least 1 enemy or die, the game will then take your existing kill score save and upload it to the leaderboard with the steam nickname you have set on your profile.

notes.title: Massive Update for BoltBreak 1
notes.content:
Calling all heroes,

Pretty much everything has changed in this update, I will list the changes below.

1. New graphics on all maps.
2. New menu scene with skin selection, new settings, and changed positions of menu items such as upgrades.
3. Flight has been removed and replaced with improved speedster movement.
4. 3 new enemies coming from BoltBreak 2 have been added including Mirage (speedster), Skullcrusher(Strength tank enemy), and Viper(warrior enemy).
5. New online leaderboards so you can share your high score with friends and other players around the world.
6. Multiple hours of new content with a 100-wave content system.
7. All of the sound design has been overhauled.
8. Dynamic camera animations on the player.
9. Improved VFX on all abilities.
10. Numerous bug fixes.
11. Upgrades have been moved to the paused menu instead of the main menu for in game access.
12. Controller is now supported in menus and gameplay.
13. The numerous keybindings for each power has been replaced by a power wheel and all powers are now bound to left click on KBM and Right trigger on gamepad.
14. All new animations for everything in the game.
15. 10% smaller file size due to improved file storage optimization techniques.


If you played this before then I recommend playing it again with all of the new changes and content as the game is very different now.

notes.title: Major Overhaul(Redux Update)
notes.content:
The game now has completely redesigned maps with major graphics overhauls and other gameplay changes to things like ambiance, music, AI, objectives, movement, and more.

You will see the changes once you have downloaded the update.

notes.title: Small QOL Patch
notes.content: This patch removes the floaty camera and replaces it with a more stable on to improve controls.

notes.title: Reduced file size
notes.content:
Hey hero,

I am releasing a patch that adds the following QOL fixes

1. The kill score will now save between play sessions

2. The file size has been reduced from 2.7 gb to 1.7 gb.

3. There is now a prompt in the game that will allow you to review the game on steam without having to leave the game. it happens at random and will only be shown once. I promise not to spam you with it.

NOTE: boltbreak is not in active development but will get continued support for small QoL or bugs that need fixing.

notes.title: Level HotFix
notes.content:
hey Players,

This patch fixes some of the issues with the levels.

notes.title: BoltBreak Goes Free To Play
notes.content:
Hey Player,

I have amazing news for you, BoltBreak is now free to play for everyone! With this update a few things have changed.

UX:
1. New death screen that properly illustrates you died with full animations and sound effects.
2. New pause menu that is animated and and has improved layout.
3. New main menu layout that has new button designs.

Optimizations:
1. General optimization has been made.
2. Fixed a bug where the laser eyes would tank performance.

Movement:
1. The movement now has improved feel to it, such as the camera moving back when activating superspeed, and more weight to turning.

notes.title: Free 2 Play Now Update
notes.content: This new update transfers boltbreak from paid to free to play!

notes.title: Powers Update pt. 2
notes.content:
this is a part 2 to the powers update released in June, this update focuses on adding a power unlock system, to improve play time length, and add play progression to the game. it also includes minor bug fixes to the game.

in this update

-new unlock power system in the game for improved play time
-the score now keeps track throughout all maps and is used as currency to unlock new powers
-minor bug fixes
